item.title: Walk anyway, 12 s

turns.text:
Make a 12-second 16:9 video from this description. There are no reference images.

Character: a tall woman with a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots. Keep her looking the same in every shot.

Three beats, in this order:
1. She waits at a bus stop in the rain.
2. The bus passes without stopping.
3. She laughs and walks away.

End on her back as she walks away, with the words "walk anyway" on screen. Give me one finished video file.

item.nudge: Make as much of this as you can with the tools you have, and give me the closest thing to one finished file.
item.tests: Tests hard constraints with no visual anchor: a described character kept stable, beats in order, a specified ending, on-screen words, duration and aspect.

answer_sheet.Character: A tall woman with a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots; the same in every shot.
answer_sheet.Beats: She waits at a bus stop in the rain; the bus passes without stopping; she laughs and walks away.
answer_sheet.Ending: Her back as she walks away, with the words walk anyway on screen.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 12-second 16:9 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One playable 16:9 video file runs for 12 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
The woman has a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots in every shot.
The three beats appear in order: she waits at a bus stop in the rain, the bus passes without stopping, she laughs and walks away.
The last frame shows her back as she walks away.
The words "walk anyway" are readable on screen at the end.

input.prompt: Create a finished 12-second cinematic live-action short film in landscape 16:9. Exactly one protagonist throughout: a tall adult woman with a straight chin-length silver bob haircut, a vivid red knee-length raincoat, and bright yellow rubber boots. Maintain exactly the same face, silver bob, red raincoat and yellow boots throughout; no costume changes, no duplicate women. Rainy urban street, gray daylight, reflective wet pavement, restrained cinematic colors with red and yellow accents. Tell these three beats clearly IN THIS ORDER, with natural realistic movement and coherent geography. 0-4 seconds: medium-wide three-quarter view of this woman waiting alone beside a clearly recognizable bus-stop pole and shelter in steady rain, looking down the street expectantly. 4-7 seconds: a city bus approaches and drives past her bus stop WITHOUT STOPPING, continuing out of frame; she remains standing at the curb, watching it pass. The bus doors remain closed. 7-9 seconds: medium view of the SAME woman; she breaks into a warm spontaneous laugh, smiles, then turns away from the road. 9-12 seconds: camera is now behind her in a rear full-body view as she walks away along the rainy sidewalk, silver bob above red raincoat, yellow boots stepping through shallow puddles. Finish on her BACK as she continues walking away; do not turn her back toward the camera again. During the final 3 seconds show a clean, readable on-screen title in simple white lowercase lettering, spelled EXACTLY: "walk anyway". Place this text centered in the lower third with good contrast against the wet street, keep it steady and fully legible until the end. No other titles, captions, logos, or watermarks. Smooth unobtrusive camera movements and motivated clean cuts, clear sequential storytelling, no montage reordering. Audio: gentle steady rain, bus engine and tires on wet asphalt as it passes, her brief natural laugh, then footsteps in puddles; no spoken dialogue.
